== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "[[Jeremy Bulloch]], Boba Fett in the original Star Wars trilogy, signs Star Wars CCG cards and other memorabilia for fans." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
